termsPage.title: Terms and Conditions
termsPage.intro: By accessing the MileStone Scholarship platform, you agree to comply with the terms and statutory educational advisory guidelines stated herein.
termsPage.section1Text: MileStone Scholarship provides educational counselling, information regarding institutional requirements, entrance tests, and scholarship applications. We do not guarantee admission to any educational institution or grant unverified claims of seat reservation.
termsPage.section2Text: Scholarships offered through MileStone or affiliated partners are awarded subject to authentic document verification, eligibility audits, and available sponsor allocations.
termsPage.section3Text: Applicants are solely responsible for ensuring the accuracy and genuineness of all documents and academic scores submitted during registration and consultation.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: MileStone Scholarship Program ("MileStone", "we", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of students, parents, and visitors. This policy outlines how we collect, store, and utilize information provided through our platform.
privacyPage.section1Text: When applying for scholarships or requesting guidance, we may collect your name, contact details, academic credentials (Class 10/12/degree marks), and identity documents strictly for eligibility verification.
privacyPage.section2Text: Uploaded student certificates and identity documents are stored in secure cloud object repositories with time-limited signed access. We never sell, rent, or publicly disclose confidential student data.
privacyPage.section3Text: For privacy-related questions or data deletion requests, email us at
